public_rationale: Later company and supplier accounts describe real steps toward agent-driven engineering. Their implementation dates are insufficiently precise to establish the state by May 19. Continued IDE use and manual review would not themselves prove no progress, because the stated vision retains human oversight. The contemporaneous absence claim remains unverified.
limitations: Later progress cannot automatically be backdated.
Company and supplier accounts are interested-party descriptions.
A deployed pilot would challenge a literal no-progress claim without establishing company-wide transformation.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Zillow has made no actual progress toward its agentic engineering vision, per sources.

statement.excerpt: In practice, sources at Zillow tell me that there has been no actual movement toward this vision.

from_speaker: no actual movement toward this vision
Software engineers still open IDEs and review code manually
our_interpretation: Assess the underlying workflow claim, not whether unnamed sources said these words.
The vision is a shift toward agents executing development stages while humans steer and approve.
No movement means no substantive implemented step toward that workflow. It does not merely mean the full vision remains incomplete.
Ordinary assistant use, spending, plans and customer-facing AI products alone do not establish that shift.
Use May 1–19, 2026 for the ongoing operational state at publication. Earlier implementations count only when evidence establishes that they remained in use during this period.
Per sources is attribution, not a conditional antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Representative dated workflow records or independently corroborated reporting establish no substantive operational adoption of the described agent-driven development process by publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated records establish at least one substantive deployed step toward that development process in use by publication, even if manual editing and review continued.

evidence.explanation: The supplier describes operational automation relevant to the vision. Its June account does not supply an implementation date establishing the May 1–19 state, so it cannot decisively contradict this observation.

evidence.locator: Section The agent gets sharper every time it fails
evidence.explanation: The surrounding account describes agents triaging bugs and proposing fixes, with human approval. It is material evidence of progress by June, but does not date this workflow closely enough to establish adoption by May 19.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Dated implementation and usage records, or independently corroborated reporting, establishing whether substantive agent-driven development workflows were operating by May 19, 2026.
